title: 8、影子（修）
content_zh:
在这座钢铁猛兽横行的监狱里如何生存？
庆尘没法指望来路不明的路广义，因为他怕自己顶替原主的身份暴露。
他也没法指望其他来自同一时空的同乡，因为对方比自己惨多了。
于是，庆尘坦然将自己的能力告知李叔同，来证明自己是一个有用的人。
毫无疑问，李叔同就是这座监狱里地位最超然的存在，自己这么做虽然冒险，但却是最好的出路。
李叔同背着手悠然离开，叶晚和大猫跟在他身旁，而林小笑则嬉皮笑脸的不知道去哪了。
中午还没到开饭时间，打饭窗口便提前为李叔同开放了。
叶晚去给李叔同和大猫各打了一份饭菜，大猫挑挑拣拣的吃着。
这时林小笑不知又从何处钻了出来，他蹬掉了自己的鞋子，光脚蹲在了李叔同餐桌对面的椅子。
大猫瞥了他一眼，叶晚则皱眉说道：“老板面前放尊重一些。”
林小笑翻了个白眼：“老板都没说啥呢，叶妈你也管的太宽了。”
李叔同笑了笑说道：“看来是有点收获？”
“对，”林小笑兴奋的说道：“太有收获了，您知道吗，这个庆尘在外面干干净净的，一点异常线索都查不到，但这样我反而来了兴趣。”
“因为太干净了？”李叔同问道。
“对，就是太干净了。他的资料显示他是18号城市的一名高中生，父母车祸身亡，继承了一笔遗产，没有前科，没有案底，没有亲人，”林小笑说道。
【看书领红包】关注公众号【书友大本营】看书抽最高888现金红包！
“他是什么罪名？”李叔同问道。
“盗窃，卷宗上显示他偷了一个刚刚够量刑的液晶电话，”林小笑说道：“您也知道这18号监狱有一半以上都是重刑犯，一般都是前科累累或者被税务机关抓到才会关在这里，他一个盗窃犯，压根就不该出现在这种地方。”
就这么一会儿的功夫，林小笑竟是连庆尘的卷宗都看过了，这在寻常人眼里恐怕已经算是手眼通天的人物了。
林小笑继续说道：“而且，我找外面的人问了一下，他这个案子存在争议，据说他声称自己是正常购买的液晶电话，钱也付过了，只是售卖电话的人不知为何没有入账，监控也突然坏了没法还他清白。所以，一旦电话销售员翻供帮他作证，或者他付钱的监控视频出现，那么他立马就能出去。您看，这是多么熟悉的手法，大部分进监狱‘办事’的人，都是这么个套路。”

李叔同若有所思：“判了他多久？”
“判了六个月，”林小笑回答道：“这怕是18号监狱历史上最短的刑期了，老板，您不觉得这很有问题吗……他还姓庆！”
庆这个姓在如今这个时代太特殊了，五大公司垄断着几乎所有的经济命脉，其中一家就姓庆。
而庆又是个很少见的姓氏，所以如果你在路上突然遇到一个姓庆的人，都会心里嘀咕对方是不是庆氏的人。
“继续，”李叔同笑着说道。
“您也知道之前庆氏集团安排进来了一个路广义，”林小笑说道：“这种东西很好查，我当时只是想不明白，对方为什么要安排这么一个小角色进来，是想干什么？”
“我记得那个路广义，”叶晚在一旁说道：“他一直在收拢人手。”
“对啊，”林小笑笑眯眯的说道：“这路广义进来以后就仗着自己机械肢体精良，一路打压监狱里的土著势力，硬生生一个月就跟其他两个派系对抗成了三足鼎立的局面，我当时就纳闷了，庆氏是送他来统一18号监狱的吗。”
“庆氏知道老板在这里，”叶晚言下之意是，有李叔同在，谁也统一不了这里。
林小笑眯起眼睛，说到兴奋处恨不得去抠自己的脚丫子：“所以啊，我还想着庆氏是不是疯了，竟然派一个小虾米来18号监狱搞事。直到今天我才明白，合着路广义是给庆尘这小子探路来了。不管庆氏想干什么，庆尘才是正主，路广义只是个跑腿的而已。”
这时候林小笑又兀自纳闷起来：“可他们来这18号监狱是图什么呢，如果庆尘这小子真的贵为庆氏嫡系，又怎么肯来这里？”
李叔同忽然说道：“庆氏可能要选下一代影子了。”
叶晚和林小笑同时愣住了：“下一代影子？庆尘是候选者之一？所以他来这里是带着任务来的。”
偌大的财团既要有面子，又要有里子。
庆氏的家主是面子，影子则是里子。
影子专门干脏活，手握权柄极重，是庆氏集团地下世界的主宰，除家主以外没人可以辖制。
只不过，每一代影子的选拔过程都异常残酷，宛如养蛊。
“看样子庆氏又要搅的大家不得安宁了啊，”李叔同感慨道。
说话间，有犯人无意间走了过来，隔着五米多远，叶晚忽然转头看向对方。
那犯人被这震慑心魄的眼神一盯，不由自主的转身朝其他方向走去。

李叔同三人都不再接着这个话题讨论下去了，林小笑转而问道：“老板，就算他是影子候选者，也没必要把身份背景搞的这么干净啊，好像跟庆氏一点关系都没有似的。”
此时大家都已经笃定，庆尘就是庆氏的人了。
到他们这种层次，最不相信的就是巧合。
“除非，这庆尘的身世里，还藏着更大的秘密，”李叔同说道。
“老板您猜到什么了？”林小笑好奇道。
李叔同摇摇头：“只是经你这么一说，我忽然觉得他长得有点像一个人。”
“敌人？还是朋友？我和叶妈见过吗，”林小笑好奇。
李叔同说道：“你们没见过他，但以后早晚都会见到的。小笑啊，这世上的关系如果能简单的用敌人与朋友来区分，那就太好了。”
说着说着，李叔同将桌子上的灰色大猫揽进了怀里，轻轻的揉着大猫的下巴。
大猫舒服的闭上了眼睛，懒洋洋的趴在了李叔同的腿上。
他对林小笑说道：“我对这个庆尘更感兴趣了，你去试试他的性格。”
林小笑惊了：“老板您看好他？他可是庆氏的人！”
“我只是让你去试探试探他而已，又没有要干什么，”李叔同笑了起来：“而且，从庆氏手里抢人，难道不是更有意思吗？”
“但我感觉他跟咱们不是一路人啊，”林小笑盯着自己的脚丫子低声嘀咕道。
李叔同笑道：“一个组织里什么样的人都得有，镇山的虎，远见的鹰，善战的狼，敏捷的豹，忠诚的狗，都有自己的职责。”
林小笑眼睛一亮：“老板，那我在组织里是什么？”
李叔同想了想：“划水的鱼。”
叶晚在一旁平静道：“搅棍的屎。”
林小笑：“？？？”

content_en:
How to survive in this prison where steel beasts are rampant?
Qingchen couldn't rely on Lu Guangyi, whose origin was unknown, because he was afraid that his identity as the original owner would be exposed.
He couldn't count on other compatriots from the same time and space, because they were much worse off than him.
Therefore, Qingchen calmly informed Li Shutong of his abilities to prove that he was a useful person.
There is no doubt that Li Shutong is the most transcendent being in this prison. Although it is risky to do this, it is the best way out.
Li Shutong left leisurely with his hands behind his back, Ye Wan and Da Mao followed him, while Lin Xiaoxiao disappeared with a playful smile on his face.
Before lunch time, the meal window was opened for Li Shutong in advance.
Ye Wan went to get a meal for Li Shutong and Da Mao each, and Da Mao ate it selectively.
At this moment, Lin Xiaoxiao emerged from nowhere. He kicked off his shoes and squatted barefoot on the chair opposite Uncle Li's dining table.
Da Mao glanced at him, and Ye Wan frowned and said, "Be respectful in front of the boss."
Lin Xiaoxiao rolled her eyes: "The boss didn't even say anything. Ye Ma, you are too lenient."
Li Shutong smiled and said, "It seems that you have gained something?"
"Yes," Lin Xiaoxiao said excitedly: "It's so rewarding. Do you know, this Qingchen is clean outside and can't find any abnormal clues, but this makes me more interested."
"Because it's too clean?" Li Shutong asked.
"Yes, it's just too clean. His information shows that he is a high school student in City No. 18. His parents died in a car accident and he inherited an inheritance. He has no criminal record, no criminal record, and no relatives," Lin Xiaoxiao said.

"What is his crime?" Li Shutong asked.
"Theft, the file shows that he stole an LCD phone that was just enough for sentencing," Lin Xiaoxiao said, "You also know that more than half of Prison No. 18 are serious criminals. They are usually locked up here because they have a lot of criminal records or were caught by the tax authorities. He is a thief and should not be in a place like this."
In just a short period of time, Lin Xiaoxiao had even read Qingchen's files. In the eyes of ordinary people, he was probably considered a person with powerful eyes and hands.
Lin Xiaoxiao continued: "Furthermore, I asked someone outside and found out that his case is controversial. It is said that he claimed that he purchased the LCD phone normally and paid the money. However, the person who sold the phone did not record the account for some reason, and the surveillance system suddenly broke down. There is no way to clear his name. So, once the telemarketer recants his confession or the surveillance video of him paying is shown, he can get out immediately. You see, this is such a familiar method, and it is the same routine for most people who go to prison to "do things."
Li Shutong thought thoughtfully: "How long will he be sentenced?"
"Six months' sentence," Lin Xiaoxiao replied: "This is probably the shortest sentence in the history of Prison No. 18. Boss, don't you think this is very problematic... His surname is Qing!"
The surname Qing is too special in today's era. Five major companies monopolize almost all economic lifelines, and one of them is surnamed Qing.
And Qing is a rare surname, so if you suddenly meet someone named Qing on the road, you will wonder if the person is from the Qing family.
"Continue," Li Shutong said with a smile.
"You also know that the Qing Group arranged for Lu Guangyi to come in before," Lin Xiaoxiao said: "This kind of thing is easy to investigate. I just couldn't figure it out at the time. Why did the other party arrange for such a small character to come in? What did they want to do?"
"I remember Lu Guangyi," Ye Wan said from the side: "He has been gathering people."
"That's right," Lin Xiaoxiao said with a smile: "After this Lu Guangyi came in, he relied on his excellent mechanical limbs to, all the way to suppress the indigenous forces in the prison, and suddenly within a month they became a tripartite confrontation with the other two factions. I was wondering at the time, was the Qing family sending him to unify Prison No. 18? "
"Qing knows that the boss is here," Ye Wan's implication is that no one can unify this place as long as Uncle Li is here.
Lin Xiaoxiao narrowed his eyes and felt so excited that he wanted to pick his own toes: "So, I was wondering if the Qing family was crazy and actually sent a little shrimp to prison No. 18 to cause trouble. It wasn’t until today that I realized that co-author Lu Guangyi was here to explore the way for this guy Qing Chen. No matter what the Qing family wants to do, Qing Chen is the real owner, Lu Guangyi is just an errand boy. "
At this time, Lin Xiaoxiao began to wonder again: "But why did they come to Prison No. 18? If Qing Chen is really a direct descendant of the Qing family, why would he come here? "
Li Shutong suddenly said: "The Qing family may have to choose the next generation of shadows. "
Ye Wan and Lin Xiaoxiao were stunned at the same time: "The next generation of shadows? Qingchen is one of the candidates? So he came here with a mission. "
Such a large financial group must have both face and dignity.
The head of the Qing family is face, and the shadow is lizi.
Shadow specializes in dirty work and holds great power. He is the master of the underground world of the Qing Group, and no one can control it except the head of the family.
However, the selection process of each generation of shadows is extremely cruel, like raising worms.
"It seems that the Qing family is going to disturb everyone's peace again," Li Shutong said with emotion.
While talking, a prisoner walked over accidentally. More than five meters away, Ye Wan suddenly turned to look at him.
The prisoner was stared at by this shocking look and involuntarily turned around and walked in another direction.
Li Shutong and the other three stopped discussing this topic, and Lin Xiaoxiao turned to ask: "Boss, even if he is a shadow candidate, there is no need to make his identity and background so clean, as if he has nothing to do with the Qing family. "
At this time, everyone was already convinced that Qingchen was from the Qing family.
At their level, the most unbelievable thing is coincidence.
"Unless there is a bigger secret hidden in Qingchen's life experience," Li Shutong said.
"Boss, what did you guess? Lin Xiaoxiao asked curiously.
Li Shutong shook his head: "Just after you said that, I suddenly felt that he looked a bit like the same person. "
"enemy? Or a friend? Have Ma Ye and I met?" Lin Xiaoxiao was curious.
Li Shutong said: "You have never seen him, but you will see him sooner or later. Xiaoxiao, it would be great if the relationships in this world could be simply distinguished by enemies and friends. "
As he spoke, Li Shutong took the big gray cat on the table into his arms and gently rubbed the big cat's chin.
The big cat closed its eyes comfortably and lay lazily on Li Shutong's lap.
He said to Lin Xiaoxiao: "I am more interested in this Qingchen, you go and try his character. "
Lin Xiaoxiao was shocked: "Boss, do you like him? He is from the Qing family! "
"I just asked you to test him, and there is nothing to do," Li Shutong laughed: "Besides, wouldn't it be more interesting to snatch people from the Qing family? "
"But I feel like he is not from the same group as us," Lin Xiaoxiao muttered in a low voice, staring at his feet.
Li Shutong smiled and said: "An organization must have all kinds of people, tigers that control mountains, eagles with foresight, wolves that are good at fighting, leopards that are agile, and dogs that are loyal. They all have their own responsibilities. "
Lin Xiaoxiao’s eyes lit up: “Boss, what am I in the organization? "
Li Shutong thought for a while: "A fish paddling in the water. "
Ye Wan said calmly from the side: "What a stirrer. "
Lin Xiaoxiao: "? ? ? "
